ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:2.5 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous high-intensity white patch on the left lobe containing localized dark circular pixel clusters; right lobe is predominantly low-intensity black with high-intensity white mottling concentrated at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression, approximately 35-40 degrees, with a vertical depth roughly 12% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concavity following a non-linear curve from the distal tips toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white circular clusters on the distal right lobe; dark-on-white punctate markings within the left lobe's primary white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular protrusions at both distal lobe tips; right tip shows a high-contrast tan/brown pixel cluster indicating organic or mineralized encrustation.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific arrangement of three dark focal marks within the white field of the left lobe resembling a symbolic or alphanumeric pattern.
